```{r}
#| include: false
MODEL_DATASET <- "QDS"
MODEL_METHOD <- "ensemble.RMSE"
MODEL_PATH <- file.path(root, "data", "summary")
MODEL_METRICS <- data.table::fread(file.path(MODEL_PATH, "metrics.csv"))[
  method == MODEL_METHOD & dataset == MODEL_DATASET,
  .(response, N = n, RMSE.log10 = rmse, R2 = r2)
]
MODEL_RESIDUALS <- data.table::fread(
  file.path(MODEL_PATH, "residuals_oof.csv")
)[
  dataset == MODEL_DATASET & is.finite(y_obs) & is.finite(y_hat_oof)
]
COLS <- c("response", "dataset", "SampleID", "y_obs", "y_hat_oof")
if (!nrow(MODEL_METRICS) || !nrow(MODEL_RESIDUALS) ||
    length(setdiff(COLS, names(MODEL_RESIDUALS)))) {
  stop("model summary: incomplete retained-model products.", call. = FALSE)
}
MODEL_RESIDUAL_CHECK <- MODEL_RESIDUALS[,
  .(rmse.residuals = sqrt(mean((y_obs - y_hat_oof)^2)),
    r2.residuals = stats::cor(y_obs, y_hat_oof)^2),
  by = response
][MODEL_METRICS, on = "response"]
if (nrow(MODEL_RESIDUAL_CHECK) != nrow(MODEL_METRICS) ||
    MODEL_RESIDUAL_CHECK[, any(!is.finite(rmse.residuals) |
      !is.finite(r2.residuals) |
      abs(rmse.residuals - RMSE.log10) > 1e-8 |
      abs(r2.residuals - R2) > 1e-8)]) {
  stop("model: residuals_oof does not reconstruct the retained ensemble metrics.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
MODEL_PHYSICAL <- MODEL_RESIDUALS[, .(
  RMSE.physical = sqrt(mean((10^y_obs - 10^y_hat_oof)^2))
), by = response]
MODEL_PERFORMANCE <- merge(MODEL_METRICS, MODEL_PHYSICAL, by = "response")

AUX <- data.table::fread(file.path(
  root, "data", "iter", "summary_0", "residuals_oof.csv"
))[
  dataset == MODEL_DATASET & is.finite(y_obs) & is.finite(y_hat_oof)
]
KEY <- c("response", "dataset", "SampleID")
if (length(setdiff(COLS, names(AUX))) ||
    AUX[, anyDuplicated(.SD), .SDcols = KEY] ||
    MODEL_RESIDUALS[, anyDuplicated(.SD), .SDcols = KEY]) {
  stop("model summary: invalid or duplicated OOF keys.", call. = FALSE)
}
MODEL_COMPARISON <- merge(
  AUX[, .(
    response, dataset, SampleID,
    y_obs.t0 = y_obs,
    y_hat.t0 = y_hat_oof
  )],
  MODEL_RESIDUALS[, .(
    response, dataset, SampleID,
    y_obs.retained = y_obs,
    y_hat.retained = y_hat_oof
  )],
  by = KEY,
  all = FALSE
)
if (nrow(MODEL_COMPARISON) != nrow(MODEL_RESIDUALS) ||
    MODEL_COMPARISON[, any(abs(y_obs.t0 - y_obs.retained) > 1e-10)]) {
  stop("model summary: t=0 and retained OOF samples are not comparable.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
MODEL_COMPARISON <- MODEL_COMPARISON[, .(
  N.common = .N,
  RMSE.reduction = 100 * (1 -
    sqrt(mean((y_obs.retained - y_hat.retained)^2)) /
    sqrt(mean((y_obs.retained - y_hat.t0)^2))),
  Delta.R2 = stats::cor(y_obs.retained, y_hat.retained)^2 -
    stats::cor(y_obs.retained, y_hat.t0)^2
), by = response]
if (!setequal(MODEL_COMPARISON$response, MODEL_PERFORMANCE$response) ||
    MODEL_COMPARISON[, any(!is.finite(RMSE.reduction) |
      !is.finite(Delta.R2))]) {
  stop("model summary: incomplete common-sample comparison.", call. = FALSE)
}

MODEL_N_RANGE <- range(MODEL_COMPARISON$N.common)
MODEL_SUPPORT_TEXT <- if (MODEL_N_RANGE[1L] == MODEL_N_RANGE[2L]) {
  sprintf("%d common observation--prediction OOF pairs per response", MODEL_N_RANGE[1L])
} else {
  sprintf(
    "between %d and %d common observation--prediction OOF pairs per response",
    MODEL_N_RANGE[1L], MODEL_N_RANGE[2L]
  )
}
MODEL_PPV <- MODEL_PERFORMANCE[grepl("^ppv", response)]
MODEL_PPA <- MODEL_PERFORMANCE[grepl("^ppa", response)]
```

The evaluation uses `r MODEL_SUPPORT_TEXT`. For PPV, OOF $R^2$ ranges from `r formatC(min(MODEL_PPV$R2), format = "f", digits = 3L)` to `r formatC(max(MODEL_PPV$R2), format = "f", digits = 3L)`, with RMSE in physical units from `r formatC(min(MODEL_PPV$RMSE.physical), format = "f", digits = 2L)` to `r formatC(max(MODEL_PPV$RMSE.physical), format = "f", digits = 2L)` mm/s. For PPA, OOF $R^2$ ranges from `r formatC(min(MODEL_PPA$R2), format = "f", digits = 3L)` to `r formatC(max(MODEL_PPA$R2), format = "f", digits = 3L)`, with RMSE in physical units from `r formatC(min(MODEL_PPA$RMSE.physical), format = "f", digits = 3L)` to `r formatC(max(MODEL_PPA$RMSE.physical), format = "f", digits = 3L)` g.

On the same observation--prediction OOF pairs, the retained formulation reduces log-scale RMSE by `r formatC(min(MODEL_COMPARISON$RMSE.reduction), format = "f", digits = 1L)` to `r formatC(max(MODEL_COMPARISON$RMSE.reduction), format = "f", digits = 1L)`% relative to $t=0$ and increases $R^2$ by `r formatC(min(MODEL_COMPARISON$Delta.R2), format = "f", digits = 3L)` to `r formatC(max(MODEL_COMPARISON$Delta.R2), format = "f", digits = 3L)` across the `r nrow(MODEL_COMPARISON)` responses. This comparison quantifies the contribution of the multi-response refinement and supports the predictive levels used for scenario construction; it does not yet constitute a geotechnical risk result.
